tenderSchedule.title: Providing Various Manpower Services on contract basis for a period of one year and extendable for six Months.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Various Manpower Services on contract basis for a period of one year and extendable for six Months.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have possessed valid registration certificate of establishing Manpower services issued by Labour department.The certificate of Registration issued by Labour Department /any Government Authority for providing Manpower Service.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have PF, ESI, Insurance, GST Certificate, Workmen Compensation Act and Factory Act Registration with the Competent Authority and proof of such Registration shall be enclosed along with the bid. The following details shall be uploaded.a)EPF Registration Number with date,b)ESI Registration Number with date.c)Bidders PAN Card Number.d)GST Registration Number with date, allotted by tax authorities.Valid Labour License issued by labour department and it should be in force, duly indicating the period of validity.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have possessed sufficient experience of having deployed at least 220 Manpower for any single executed contract for the following category such as Commerce graduate, Engineer, Diploma in business admin, DEO, Painter/Weldor, Electrician/fitter/turner, Helpers in Karnataka having experience for last 2 Years. (**There should not have any service breakup in above category for the last 2 years). Qualification for the tender, the quantity of deployment of manpower services should be categorized as mentioned below and, in each category, quantity should be more than the specified numbers mentioned in the table and the total quantity shall be minimum of 51.Satisfactorily completed Certificate shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of ISO-9001-2015 Copy of ISO 45001:2018Relevant document uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish the Performance Certificate issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer of the concerned departments for having provided Manpower services not less than the tendered Manpower services in any KPTCL/ESCOMs/State/Central Govt. factoryPerformance Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer of the concerned State/Central Govt. factory/ KPTCL/ ESCOMS

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in providing Manpower services.Work award/Order Completion Certificates in respect of experience of minimum 5 years in providing Manpower services issued by any KPTCL/ESCOMs/ Government Departments/ Boards/ PSUs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have obtained order for providing Manpower services to Govt. Dept/Corporations/local bodies on contract basis with minimum strength not less than 300 man power and the award must be in a single contract in any one year in the last Three years.Work Award copies/Order completion certificate placed by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer should be not less than the amount put to tender during the last 3 preceding financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25). However, it will be 50% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises in last 2 preceding financial yearsCertified copies of audited Financial statements such as P&L statement, Balance sheets for the FY (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) Shall be uploaded With UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Bidder must not have UNSATISFIED/DEFAULTED in supplies against Work Orders placed by any ESCOMs/ any Government Utilities / PSUs/ Public Limited Companies. Self-declaration shall be uploaded by the Bidder. Self-Declaration by the Bidder.
The Bidder shall be an assesses of Income Tax, a copy of latest IT returns shall be furnished.Latest IT returns.

The Bidder shall upload a declaration stating that the firm has not been BLACK LISTED in supplies against Work Orders placed by any ESCOMs/any Government Utilities/ PSUs/ Public Limited Companies as on the date of bid opening. Self-declaration shall be uploaded by the Bidder.Self-Declaration by the Bidder.
